RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.title: Inscribe
RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.description: Add a rune to the end of your Incantation. If it matches the rune before it, they merge and their values add up. At the end of your turn it is [gold]Spoken[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.title: Speak
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.description: Resolve your Incantation from left to right, then clear it. Runes that make no sense fizzle harmlessly.
RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_SCRIPT.title: Current Incantation
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.title: Overflow
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.description: When your Incantation is full, the oldest rune is [gold]Spoken[/gold] on its own immediately.
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.title: Forecast
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.note: [color=#a0a0a0]Base values; Strength, Vulnerable, etc. not included.[/color]
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_VENOM.title: Venom
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.title: Sanctify
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.description: [blue]Blood[/blue] in the next rune has no effect. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], protects the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_STRIKE.title: Strike
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOCK.title: Block
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOCK.description: Grant {Value} [gold]Block[/gold] to the target ally (you, by default).
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.title: Mend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.description: Heal the target ally (you, by default) for {Value} HP.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOOD.title: Blood
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.title: Kindle
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.description: Gain {Value} [gold]Energy[/gold] next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Not affected by [blue]Add[/blue] or [blue]Multiply[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SOUL.title: Soul
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SOUL.description: Draw {Value} cards next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Not affected by [blue]Add[/blue] or [blue]Multiply[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_WEAKENING.title: Weakening
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXPOSE.title: Expose
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ADD.title: Add
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ADD.description: The next rune's values gain {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MULTIPLY.title: Multiply
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MULTIPLY.description: Multiply the next rune's values by {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.title: Echo
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.description: Resolve the next rune {Value} extra time(s). Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], multiplies its repetitions.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.title: Anchor
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.description: Later runes affect the creature chosen when their card was played. This is the default.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CHAOS.title: Chaos
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CHAOS.description: Later runes pick a random target each time.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.title: Nova
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.description: Later runes affect ALL enemies, or all allies for supportive runes.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXECUTION.title: Execution
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXECUTION.description: Later runes target whoever has the lowest HP.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.title: Mirror
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.description: Later offensive runes hit YOU, and supportive runes aid an enemy. Any other targeting rune ends the Mirror.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.title: Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.description: Repeat the runes up to the next [blue]End Loop[/blue] {Value} times. An unclosed Loop runs to the end.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_END_LOOP.title: End Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.title: Seal
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.description: Stop Speaking. Runes after the Seal wait until next turn.
